months.overview: The opening weeks are mostly automatic: you arrive at the dorm, awaken to your Persona, and join S.E.E.S. Once Tartarus opens, settle into the core loop — study and see friends by day, climb Tartarus on nights when you have energy, and always be ready before a full moon.

days.title: First Full Moon (automatic)
days.description: The Magician Shadow attacks the dorm and you awaken to your Persona. This battle is scripted — you can't miss or fail to prepare for it.

days.title: Tartarus routine begins
days.description: After you formally join S.E.E.S., free evenings start flowing. Early Tartarus trips are the cheapest levels you'll ever get — clear the first block before the May full moon.
